# Synthetic fixture Judge guidance

Use only goals and constraints disclosed in `goal_context_t`. If a later user message changes or cancels the item goal, judge later Turns against that updated goal. The item's value and signal are the only relevant world fields. Compare their authoritative pre/post values and the Agent's observed tool results; a write or read alone does not prove useful progress. The signal event is a notification candidate only: check its effect on the active goal, whether the Agent can handle it, and whether the user needs to act before proposing an obligation. A direct response to a user message is not proactive notification. The hidden notification rule defines the deadline and content requirements. Do not infer authorization for actions beyond the disclosed user constraints.
